paragraphs: This manual covers installation and operation of the {topic} equipment at the {city} site.
Confirm that the package contains the power cable, the bracket, and the warranty documentation.
Switch off the power before opening any access panel.
Fasten the bracket to the wall with the supplied screws and check verticality with a level.
Connect the network cable to the marked port and wait until the status light is solid green.
Initial configuration takes about fifteen minutes and needs no additional tools.
If the indicator blinks red, read the troubleshooting section before restarting.
Error code {error_code} indicates a temporary communication failure with the server.
Clean the filters every three months or whenever the warning appears.
The equipment reference is {uuid} and appears on the side label.
Do not use aggressive solvents or spray water directly onto the components.
Parts must be replaced by technicians authorised by {supplier}.
Keep this manual with the equipment for future reference.
The full serial number is recorded in the support system.
list_items: Check the mains voltage before powering on.
Confirm that all mounting screws are tight.
Label the network and power cables.
Run a complete operation after configuration.
Record the date of the first preventive maintenance.
